title: `voids/plenitude-void` overstates its evidence: the opening says unreported content "is not actually registered" (contradicted by Nartker et al. 2025, which `concepts/phenomenal-overflow` already reports); the lead and check-and-find loop state "attention generates detail" as fact on Posner (1980); the Relation section calls processing "demonstrably sparse" against the page's own bandwidth figures and never addresses Bidirectional Interaction
